senses.en: To eat a meal, especially dinner.

ex.en: We dined outside beside the river last night.
ex.zh: 昨晚我们在河边的露天座位用餐。

ex.en: Tourists who dine at locally owned restaurants can support small businesses and experience regional food traditions.
ex.zh: 在当地人经营的餐馆用餐，游客既能支持小企业，也能体验地方饮食传统。

col: dine with friends｜与朋友共进餐
dine at a restaurant｜在餐馆用餐
tip: 比eat正式，通常不直接接食物作宾语。

senses.en: the body part where an arm joins the upper body
to accept responsibility for something difficult

ex.en: She rested her head on her father's shoulder.
ex.zh: 她把头靠在父亲的肩膀上。

ex.en: Governments and businesses must shoulder greater responsibility for reducing the environmental impact of industrial production.
ex.zh: 政府和企业必须承担更大的责任，减少工业生产对环境的影响。

tip: 作动词常接responsibility或burden，表示承担。

senses.en: A set of tools or equipment for a particular activity
A set of parts used to build something

ex.en: We keep a first aid kit in the car.
ex.zh: 我们在车里备有一个急救包。

ex.en: Schools should provide basic science kits so that all pupils can take part in practical experiments.
ex.zh: 学校应提供基础科学实验套件，让所有学生都能参与动手实验。

col: kit someone out｜给某人配齐装备
tip: kit指成套用品；kit sb out表示给某人配装备。

senses.en: to praise someone or something, often publicly
to recommend someone or something as worthy of consideration

ex.en: The coach commended Lina for helping her teammates.
ex.zh: 教练表扬莉娜帮助了队友。

ex.en: Inspectors commended the school for providing additional support to students with different learning needs.
ex.zh: 督察人员赞扬该校为有不同学习需求的学生提供额外支持。

col: commend someone for something｜因某事表扬某人
commend something to someone｜向某人推荐某物
tip: commend是称赞；command是命令，注意拼写。

senses.en: to focus your mind calmly, often as a mental exercise
to think deeply and carefully about something

ex.en: I meditate for ten minutes before breakfast each morning.
ex.zh: 我每天早饭前都会冥想十分钟。

ex.en: Some employers encourage staff to meditate during breaks as a way of managing workplace stress.
ex.zh: 一些雇主鼓励员工在休息时冥想，以缓解工作压力。

col: meditate on something｜深入思考某事
tip: 表示深思某事，常用meditate on或upon。

senses.en: to involve someone deeply in an activity or experience
to put something completely beneath the surface of a liquid

ex.en: On rainy afternoons, I immerse myself in a novel.
ex.zh: 下雨的午后，我会沉浸在小说中。

ex.en: Exchange programmes allow students to immerse themselves in another culture and develop greater independence.
ex.zh: 交流项目让学生深入体验另一种文化，并培养更强的独立性。

col: immerse yourself in｜使自己沉浸于
tip: 沉浸于某事用immerse yourself in，注意反身代词。

senses.en: To make someone seem foolish by laughing at or imitating them.
Made to imitate something real, often for practice.
A practice examination taken before the real one.

ex.en: Please don't mock my dancing; I'm still learning.
ex.zh: 请别嘲笑我的舞姿，我还在学呢。

ex.en: Mock interviews allow students to practise explaining their skills before they apply for their first professional positions.
ex.zh: 模拟面试让学生在申请第一份专业工作前，练习如何介绍自己的技能。

col: mock someone's accent｜嘲笑某人的口音
tip: mock作动词直接接宾语，不加at。

senses.en: the period when a king or queen rules
to rule as a king or queen
to be the strongest or most noticeable condition

ex.en: This castle was built during a young queen's reign.
ex.zh: 这座城堡建于一位年轻女王在位期间。

ex.en: During the king's reign, investment in public libraries made education more accessible to ordinary citizens.
ex.zh: 在这位国王统治期间，对公共图书馆的投入让普通民众更容易获得教育。

col: during the reign of｜在……统治期间
a long reign｜漫长的统治时期
tip: 与rain同音；reign指统治，rein指缰绳。

senses.en: Travelling faster than sound, or involving such speeds.

ex.en: We heard a loud boom as the supersonic aircraft passed.
ex.zh: 超音速飞机飞过时，我们听到了一声巨响。

ex.en: Supersonic passenger aircraft could shorten international journeys, but their noise and fuel consumption remain major concerns.
ex.zh: 超音速客机可以缩短国际旅程，但其噪声和燃油消耗仍是主要问题。

tip: 指速度超过声速；“超声波的”通常用ultrasonic。

senses.en: to keep returning to someone's mind and causing distress
for a ghost to appear repeatedly in a place
a place someone visits frequently

ex.en: That embarrassing mistake still haunts me before every presentation.
ex.zh: 每次做报告前，那个令人尴尬的错误仍会困扰我。

ex.en: The consequences of poor urban planning can haunt communities long after the original decisions are made.
ex.zh: 糟糕的城市规划所带来的后果，可能在最初决策作出很久之后仍困扰社区。

col: be haunted by memories｜被回忆困扰
haunt an old house｜在老房子里出没
a favourite haunt｜最爱常去的地方
tip: 作动词直接接宾语；be haunted by表示受困扰。

senses.en: To go to see a person or place.
An occasion when someone goes to see someone or somewhere.

ex.en: We visited our neighbours and shared some homemade soup.
ex.zh: 我们去拜访邻居，和他们分享了一些自制的汤。

ex.en: Students who visit science museums can connect classroom theories with practical examples from everyday life.
ex.zh: 参观科学博物馆的学生能够把课堂理论与日常生活中的实际例子联系起来。

col: pay a visit to｜拜访；参观
a guided visit｜有导游陪同的参观
tip: 动词visit后直接接宾语；名词用a visit to。

senses.en: A tool with a broad blade for moving loose material.
To lift or move material using a shovel.

ex.en: I used a shovel to clear the snowy path.
ex.zh: 我用铲子清除了小路上的积雪。

ex.en: Community volunteers shovelled soil into raised beds to create a garden on unused urban land.
ex.zh: 社区志愿者把土铲进高架种植床，在闲置的城市土地上建起花园。

tip: 英式过去式为shovelled，美式为shoveled。

senses.en: A frog-like animal with rough skin that usually lives on land.

ex.en: A small toad was hiding beneath the garden pot.
ex.zh: 一只小蟾蜍躲在花园的花盆下面。

ex.en: Protecting ponds and nearby woodland helps toads survive as urban development reduces their natural habitats.
ex.zh: 城市开发使蟾蜍的自然栖息地缩小，保护池塘及附近林地有助于它们生存。

tip: toad指蟾蜍；frog通常指青蛙。

senses.en: A short trip to buy, collect, or deliver something

ex.en: I ran an errand before meeting you for lunch.
ex.zh: 和你见面吃午饭前，我出去办了点事。

ex.en: Reliable neighbourhood transport helps older residents run errands independently and maintain regular contact with their communities.
ex.zh: 可靠的社区交通能帮助老年居民独立外出办事，并与社区保持日常联系。

col: send someone on an errand｜派某人跑腿
a quick errand｜很快能办完的差事
tip: 通常指外出办小事；常搭配run errands。

senses.zh: 弄清， 查明； 确定

senses.en: Specific methods used to achieve a goal or gain an advantage.

ex.en: Our coach changed tactics halfway through the football match.
ex.zh: 足球比赛进行到一半时，我们的教练改变了战术。

ex.en: Companies increasingly use digital marketing tactics to attract younger consumers and compete in crowded markets.
ex.zh: 企业越来越多地采用数字营销策略来吸引年轻消费者，并在竞争激烈的市场中争得优势。

tip: strategy侧重整体战略，tactics侧重具体手段。

senses.en: A plant used to flavour food or make medicines.

ex.en: She grows fresh herbs in pots beside the kitchen window.
ex.zh: 她在厨房窗边的花盆里种了新鲜香草。

ex.en: Growing herbs at home can encourage healthier cooking and reduce the need for packaged seasonings.
ex.zh: 在家种植香草可以鼓励更健康的烹饪方式，并减少对包装调味料的需求。

tip: 英音h发音，美音通常不发；对应a herb和an herb。

senses.en: A long, narrow cut or hollow in a surface.
A strong, steady rhythm that makes music feel engaging.
To cut long, narrow hollows into a surface.

ex.en: Dust had collected in every groove of the wooden door.
ex.zh: 木门的每一道凹槽里都积了灰。

ex.en: The grooves in vehicle tyres channel water away, improving grip and reducing accident risks on wet roads.
ex.zh: 汽车轮胎上的沟槽能够排水，增强抓地力，降低湿滑路面上的事故风险。

col: get into a groove｜进入顺畅状态
tip: 具体指表面的长凹槽；音乐中可指鲜明的律动。

senses.en: A large building where goods are stored before distribution
Store goods in a warehouse

ex.en: The warehouse behind the station stores furniture and kitchen equipment.
ex.zh: 车站后面的仓库存放着家具和厨房设备。

ex.en: Locating a warehouse near major transport routes can reduce delivery costs and improve supply chain efficiency.
ex.zh: 将仓库设在主要运输线路附近可以降低配送成本，提高供应链效率。

tip: 指储存货物的大型建筑；动词用法较正式。

senses.en: Cloth or paper used to wipe your mouth while eating

ex.en: He wiped the soup from his chin with a napkin.
ex.zh: 他用餐巾擦掉下巴上的汤。

ex.en: Restaurants can reduce waste by replacing disposable paper napkins with reusable cloth alternatives, provided laundering is managed efficiently.
ex.zh: 只要高效安排洗涤，餐馆就能用可重复使用的布餐巾替代一次性餐巾纸来减少垃圾。

tip: 现代常指餐巾；“尿布”英式通常用nappy。

senses.en: Someone who takes part in an activity or event.

ex.en: Each participant brought a homemade dish to the cooking workshop.
ex.zh: 每位参与者都带了一道自制菜来参加烹饪工作坊。

ex.en: Every participant in the research project gave informed consent before sharing information about their daily exercise habits.
ex.zh: 研究项目的每位参与者都在知情同意后，才分享了自己的日常锻炼习惯信息。

col: participant in a study｜研究参与者
tip: 常作名词；表示某活动的参与者用participant in。

senses.en: Someone who watches an event, especially a sporting event.

ex.en: A spectator caught the ball near the fence.
ex.zh: 一名观众在围栏附近接住了球。

ex.en: Major sporting events attract thousands of spectators and can generate substantial income for local businesses.
ex.zh: 大型体育赛事吸引成千上万的观众，并能为当地商家带来可观收入。

tip: 常指体育赛事现场观众；演出观众多用audience。

senses.en: A measurable factor used to describe a system or calculation.
A limit or condition controlling how something can be done.

ex.en: You can adjust this parameter to sharpen the image.
ex.zh: 你可以调整这个参数，让图像更清晰。

ex.en: Researchers must identify the key parameters affecting energy consumption before developing reliable models of urban demand.
ex.zh: 研究人员必须先确定影响能源消耗的关键参数，才能建立可靠的城市需求模型。

col: within the parameters｜在限定范围内
tip: 表限定条件时常用复数；勿与周长perimeter混淆。

senses.en: an instruction stating what is allowed or required
control of a country or people by a leader or group
to govern a country or make an official legal decision

ex.en: Our main rule is to leave muddy shoes outside.
ex.zh: 我们最主要的规矩是把沾泥的鞋子留在外面。

ex.en: Clear rules on industrial waste disposal are essential for protecting rivers and ensuring safe drinking water.
ex.zh: 关于工业废物处理的明确规定对于保护河流和保障饮用水安全至关重要。

tip: as a rule意为“通常”；rule out意为“排除”。

senses.en: a religious talk given during a service
a long talk telling someone how they should behave

ex.en: The sermon encouraged everyone to help their neighbours.
ex.zh: 这场布道鼓励大家帮助邻居。

ex.en: A sermon can strengthen community ties by encouraging listeners to support vulnerable people and participate in local projects.
ex.zh: 布道可以鼓励听众帮助弱势群体、参与本地项目，从而加强社区联系。

col: a sermon on kindness｜关于善意的布道
tip: 本义为宗教讲道；比喻“说教”时常带不满。

senses.en: A difference of opinion or an argument about it.

ex.en: We had a disagreement about whose turn it was.
ex.zh: 我们为该轮到谁了发生了争执。

ex.en: Disagreement over public spending priorities is inevitable, but transparent discussions can help governments build broader support.
ex.zh: 在公共支出优先事项上出现分歧不可避免，但透明的讨论能帮助政府获得更广泛的支持。

col: a disagreement over something｜关于某事的分歧
tip: 具体争执可数；泛指意见不合时通常不可数。

senses.en: Very unhappy, uncomfortable, or unfortunate.
Extremely bad in quality or condition.

ex.en: I felt wretched after spending the night coughing.
ex.zh: 咳嗽了一整晚后，我感到十分难受。

ex.en: Families living in wretched housing conditions face greater risks of respiratory illness and other health problems.
ex.zh: 居住条件恶劣的家庭面临更高的呼吸系统疾病及其他健康问题风险。

tip: 开头w不发音；词尾-ed在此读/ɪd/。

senses.en: unable to work or exist together successfully
too different in character to have a good relationship

ex.en: These headphones are incompatible with my old phone.
ex.zh: 这副耳机与我的旧手机不兼容。

ex.en: Rapid industrial expansion is often incompatible with efforts to protect fragile ecosystems without effective regulation.
ex.zh: 如果缺乏有效监管，工业快速扩张往往与保护脆弱生态系统的努力相冲突。

tip: 固定搭配为incompatible with，不用incompatible to。

senses.en: missing some parts or not yet finished

ex.en: The puzzle is incomplete because several pieces are missing.
ex.zh: 这幅拼图不完整，因为少了好几块。

ex.en: Policies based on incomplete data may fail to address the needs of the most vulnerable communities.
ex.zh: 基于不完整数据制定的政策，可能无法满足最弱势群体的需求。

col: an incomplete application｜材料不全的申请
tip: incomplete可指缺少部分，也可指工作尚未做完。

senses.zh: 不透明的， 不透光的； 难理解的， 晦涩的

senses.en: the feeling that something is not as good as expected

ex.en: He expressed his dissatisfaction with the cold meal politely.
ex.zh: 他礼貌地表达了对饭菜冰凉的不满。

ex.en: Growing dissatisfaction with public transport has encouraged local authorities to review bus routes and fares.
ex.zh: 公众对公共交通日益不满，促使地方当局重新审视公交线路和票价。

tip: 通常不可数；对某事不满用dissatisfaction with。

senses.en: Made so that water cannot enter or escape
Having no weaknesses that allow doubt or challenge

ex.en: This watertight box keeps my camera dry during boat trips.
ex.zh: 这个密封防水盒让我乘船出游时相机也能保持干燥。

ex.en: Governments need watertight regulations to prevent companies from avoiding responsibility for environmental damage caused by their operations.
ex.zh: 政府需要严密的法规，防止企业逃避其经营活动造成的环境损害责任。

col: a watertight container｜密封防水容器
a watertight argument｜无懈可击的论证
tip: 既指不漏水，也可形容论证或协议严密。

senses.en: in a way that cannot be prevented or avoided

ex.en: Without regular watering, these flowers will inevitably die.
ex.zh: 如果不定期浇水，这些花必然会枯死。

ex.en: A growing population will inevitably increase demand for housing unless household sizes change significantly.
ex.zh: 除非家庭规模发生显著变化，否则人口增长必然会增加住房需求。

tip: 语气比probably强，表示结果无法避免。

senses.en: Without considering or being affected by something, used with of.

ex.en: Everyone can join the walk, irrespective of their age.
ex.zh: 无论年龄大小，人人都可以参加这次步行活动。

ex.en: Quality education should be available to all children, irrespective of their family income or social background.
ex.zh: 所有儿童都应能获得优质教育，无论其家庭收入或社会背景如何。

col: irrespective of the outcome｜不论结果如何
tip: 通常用irrespective of＋名词，意为“不论”。

senses.en: not completely correct or exact

ex.en: The map was inaccurate, so we missed the turning.
ex.zh: 地图不准确，所以我们错过了转弯处。

ex.en: Inaccurate information online can undermine public trust and lead people to make poorly informed decisions.
ex.zh: 网上的不准确信息可能削弱公众信任，并导致人们在缺乏可靠信息的情况下作出决定。

tip: 指信息或测量不准确；不一定意味着故意造假。

senses.en: Not fair, sensible, or willing to accept good reasons.
Greater than is fair or acceptable.

ex.en: It seems unreasonable to blame you for the weather.
ex.zh: 因为天气不好而责怪你，似乎很不讲理。

ex.en: Expecting employees to answer messages throughout their holidays places unreasonable demands on their time and harms wellbeing.
ex.zh: 要求员工整个假期都回复消息，是对其时间的过分索取，也会损害身心健康。

tip: 可形容人不讲理，也可形容要求或价格过分。

senses.en: not suitable or good enough for a particular purpose
not physically healthy or strong, often through lack of exercise

ex.en: The rusty bicycle was unfit for the long journey.
ex.zh: 那辆生锈的自行车不适合用来长途骑行。

ex.en: Poor maintenance can make public housing unfit for occupation, putting additional pressure on local authorities.
ex.zh: 维护不善可能使公共住房不宜居住，给地方政府带来额外压力。

col: unfit for purpose｜不符合用途要求
unfit for human consumption｜不宜供人食用
tip: 常用unfit for sth或unfit to do sth。

senses.en: Completely unreasonable or silly.

ex.en: It seems absurd to drive when the shop is so close.
ex.zh: 商店这么近还要开车去，似乎太不合理了。

ex.en: It is absurd to expect public transport use to increase without improving service quality or affordability.
ex.zh: 不提高服务质量或降低出行成本，却指望公共交通使用量增加，这是不合理的。

tip: 常用句式：It is absurd to do sth.。

senses.en: To ignore something or treat it as unimportant.
A lack of attention or respect for something.

ex.en: Please disregard my earlier message; the picnic is still happening.
ex.zh: 请忽略我之前的消息，野餐仍会照常举行。

ex.en: Companies that disregard environmental regulations may reduce short-term costs but create lasting damage to local ecosystems.
ex.zh: 无视环保法规的企业可能降低短期成本，却会对当地生态系统造成持久损害。

col: complete disregard for｜对……的完全漠视
disregard for safety｜对安全的漠视
tip: 动词直接接宾语；名词常用disregard for。

senses.en: A warm-blooded animal whose females produce milk for their young.

ex.en: A dolphin is a mammal, even though it lives underwater.
ex.zh: 海豚虽然生活在水下，却是哺乳动物。

ex.en: Protecting marine mammals requires international cooperation because these animals often migrate across the waters of several countries.
ex.zh: 保护海洋哺乳动物需要国际合作，因为这些动物经常跨越多个国家的水域迁徙。

tip: 鲸和海豚也是哺乳动物；不能按栖息地判断。

senses.en: Concerned with reducing suffering and improving people's lives.
Someone who works to reduce suffering and improve human welfare.

ex.en: Volunteers packed blankets and medicine for the humanitarian mission.
ex.zh: 志愿者为这次人道主义援助行动打包了毛毯和药品。

ex.en: International humanitarian organisations provide essential supplies to communities affected by natural disasters and armed conflict.
ex.zh: 国际人道主义组织向遭受自然灾害和武装冲突的社区提供必需物资。

tip: 强调减轻人类苦难，不等同于一般的慷慨。

senses.en: A flat-bottomed boat carrying goods on rivers or canals
To move roughly or rudely past people or into somewhere

ex.en: A barge loaded with sand passed beneath the bridge.
ex.zh: 一艘满载沙子的驳船从桥下驶过。

ex.en: Transporting construction materials by barge can reduce the number of heavy vehicles travelling through crowded urban areas.
ex.zh: 用驳船运输建筑材料可以减少穿行拥挤城区的重型车辆。

col: barge into a room｜闯入房间
barge past someone｜硬挤过某人身旁
tip: 动词常搭配in或into，含鲁莽闯入之意。

senses.en: A change in level or amount, especially up and down.

ex.en: A sudden temperature fluctuation made the shower briefly cold.
ex.zh: 水温突然波动，让淋浴的水短暂变凉了。

ex.en: Frequent fluctuations in food prices make it difficult for low-income households to plan their monthly spending.
ex.zh: 食品价格频繁波动，使低收入家庭难以规划每月开支。

tip: 常用fluctuations in加变化的指标，如prices。

senses.en: a hospital room or section for patients receiving similar care
a local district used for administration or elections
a person legally protected by a guardian or court

ex.en: A nurse brought fresh blankets into the children's ward.
ex.zh: 一名护士把干净的毯子送进了儿科病房。

ex.en: Expanding hospital wards alone will not improve healthcare unless sufficient trained staff are also available.
ex.zh: 如果没有足够的专业医护人员，仅扩建医院病区并不能改善医疗服务。

tip: 作动词通常用ward off，表示抵挡、避开。

senses.en: Physical power to lift, move, or resist something.
A quality or skill that makes someone or something effective.
How strong, powerful, or resistant to damage something is.

ex.en: I needed all my strength to lift the suitcase.
ex.zh: 我使出全身力气才提起那个手提箱。

ex.en: Schools should help students identify their strengths rather than judge everyone solely through written examinations.
ex.zh: 学校应帮助学生发现自己的长处，而不是仅凭笔试评判所有人。

tip: 表示力气通常不可数；表示长处可数。

senses.en: Covered with ice.
Extremely cold.
Showing no warmth or friendliness.

ex.en: We walked slowly along the icy path this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早晨，我们沿着结冰的小路慢慢走。

ex.en: Local authorities should treat icy roads promptly to reduce accidents and maintain reliable public transport.
ex.zh: 地方政府应及时处理结冰路面，以减少事故并保障公共交通可靠运行。

col: an icy stare｜冷冰冰的凝视
tip: icy既可指覆冰或极冷，也可形容态度冷漠。

senses.en: A standard used to judge something or make a decision.

ex.en: Price was my main criterion when choosing a bicycle.
ex.zh: 选自行车时，价格是我的主要衡量标准。

ex.en: Environmental impact should be a key criterion when governments assess proposals for new transport infrastructure.
ex.zh: 政府评估新交通基础设施提案时，应将环境影响作为重要标准。

col: meet a criterion｜符合一项标准
tip: 单数criterion，复数criteria；不能说a criteria。

senses.en: a usual situation or accepted standard
an accepted rule for behaviour within a group

ex.en: Working from home is now the norm in our team.
ex.zh: 居家办公如今已成为我们团队的常态。

ex.en: Social norms influence how people interact, although acceptable behaviour can vary significantly across cultures.
ex.zh: 社会规范影响人们的交往方式，但不同文化所接受的行为可能差异很大。

tip: 表示“常态”常用the norm；行为规范常用复数。

senses.en: The point just before something happens.
A strip of grass beside a road.
To come close to a particular state or quality.

ex.en: She was on the verge of tears after losing her ring.
ex.zh: 她丢了戒指，几乎要哭出来了。

ex.en: Several native species are on the verge of extinction because their habitats have been severely damaged.
ex.zh: 几种本地物种因栖息地遭到严重破坏而濒临灭绝。

col: on the verge of extinction｜濒临灭绝
on the verge of doing something｜即将做某事
verge on the absurd｜近乎荒谬
tip: on the verge of后接名词或动名词；动词常接on。

senses.en: A space in a wall where a fire burns.

ex.en: We warmed our feet beside the fireplace after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭后，我们在壁炉旁暖脚。

ex.en: Traditional homes often feature a fireplace, although modern heating systems are generally more convenient.
ex.zh: 传统住宅通常设有壁炉，不过现代供暖系统一般更方便。

col: light a fire in the fireplace｜在壁炉里生火
tip: 壁炉是fireplace；壁炉架通常叫mantelpiece。

senses.en: Someone who supports an artist, organisation, or activity, often financially.
A customer of a restaurant, theatre, or similar place.

ex.en: A local patron paid for the young artist's materials.
ex.zh: 一位当地赞助人出钱为这位年轻艺术家购买了材料。

ex.en: Private patrons can fund experimental art that might otherwise struggle to attract public financial support.
ex.zh: 私人赞助人能够资助那些可能难以获得公共资金支持的实验艺术。

col: patron of the arts｜艺术赞助人
tip: patron既指资助者，也可正式地指餐馆等的顾客。

senses.en: Silently showing anger or unhappiness and refusing to be friendly.

ex.en: He gave a sullen shrug and stared at the floor.
ex.zh: 他闷闷不乐地耸了耸肩，盯着地板。

ex.en: Students who feel excluded may become sullen and less willing to participate in classroom discussions.
ex.zh: 感到被排斥的学生可能变得郁郁不乐，也更不愿参与课堂讨论。

col: a sullen mood｜闷闷不乐的心情
tip: 强调生气或不快时沉默、不友好的样子。

senses.en: A strip of material wrapped around an injury for protection.
To wrap an injured body part in a bandage.

ex.en: The nurse wrapped a clean bandage around my ankle.
ex.zh: 护士用干净的绷带包住了我的脚踝。

ex.en: Basic first aid courses teach people how to apply a bandage safely before professional help arrives.
ex.zh: 基础急救课程教人们如何在专业救援到来前安全地使用绷带。

tip: 既是名词也是动词；bandage a wound意为包扎伤口。

senses.en: the most important quality that makes something what it is
a concentrated liquid containing a particular flavour or scent

ex.en: For me, the essence of friendship is being there.
ex.zh: 对我来说，友谊的真谛就是陪伴与支持。

ex.en: The essence of sustainable development is meeting present needs without limiting opportunities for future generations.
ex.zh: 可持续发展的本质是满足当代需求，同时不限制后代的发展机会。

tip: in essence 表示“本质上”，用于概括核心观点。

senses.en: a departure from an expected route, rule, or behaviour
the difference between a measurement and a reference value

ex.en: A small deviation from our route revealed a quiet beach.
ex.zh: 我们稍稍偏离原定路线，发现了一片安静的海滩。

ex.en: Any significant deviation from established safety procedures should be investigated to prevent accidents in the workplace.
ex.zh: 任何严重偏离既定安全程序的行为都应得到调查，以防止工作场所事故。

col: deviation from the norm｜偏离常态
tip: 常用 deviation from；standard deviation 是“标准差”。

senses.en: Relating to the region around the North Pole.
Extremely cold.
The region surrounding the North Pole.

ex.en: An arctic fox curled up beside a snowy rock.
ex.zh: 一只北极狐蜷缩在一块覆雪的岩石旁。

ex.en: Rising temperatures threaten arctic wildlife by reducing the sea ice that many species depend on.
ex.zh: 气温升高使许多物种赖以生存的海冰减少，威胁着北极野生动物。

tip: 指北极地区时用the Arctic；南极是the Antarctic。

senses.en: Causing deep sadness, especially through death or serious suffering.
Relating to a serious play or story with an unhappy ending.

ex.en: The film tells a tragic story of lost friendship.
ex.zh: 这部电影讲述了一个关于友谊破裂的悲伤故事。

ex.en: Tragic accidents on busy roads highlight the need for safer crossings and stricter enforcement of speed limits.
ex.zh: 繁忙道路上的惨痛事故凸显了设置更安全的过街设施及严格执行限速规定的必要性。

col: a tragic loss｜令人悲痛的损失
tip: 比sad程度更重，常涉及死亡或严重不幸。

senses.en: an object that burns or explodes with bright colours outdoors

ex.en: A single firework burst above the lake, scattering golden sparks.
ex.zh: 一枚烟花在湖面上空绽放，洒下金色火花。

ex.en: Public firework displays can attract visitors, although their noise may disturb local residents and wildlife.
ex.zh: 公共焰火表演可以吸引游客，但其噪声可能打扰当地居民和野生动物。

tip: 单枚烟花可数；泛指烟花或焰火表演常用fireworks。

senses.en: severe weather with strong winds and rain, snow, or thunder
to move somewhere angrily and forcefully
a sudden wave of strong public anger or criticism

ex.en: We stayed indoors while the storm shook the windows.
ex.zh: 暴风雨震得窗户直响，我们一直待在屋里。

ex.en: Coastal communities need stronger flood defences to protect homes and essential services during severe storms.
ex.zh: 沿海社区需要更坚固的防洪设施，以在强风暴期间保护住房和基本公共服务。

col: a storm of protest｜抗议浪潮
storm out of the room｜怒气冲冲地走出房间
tip: storm out表示愤然离开，不是风暴向外移动。

senses.en: cruel government that uses power without limits
cruel or unreasonable control over other people

ex.en: The film follows a village struggling against a ruler's tyranny.
ex.zh: 这部电影讲述一个村庄反抗统治者暴政的故事。

ex.en: Independent courts and a free press can help prevent tyranny by holding political leaders accountable.
ex.zh: 独立的法院和自由的新闻媒体可以通过追究政治领导人的责任来帮助防止暴政。

col: the tyranny of the majority｜多数人的暴政
tip: 强调权力的残酷滥用，比一般的严格管理更严重。

senses.en: A leopard or jaguar with a black coat.
A cougar, especially in North American usage.

ex.en: The black panther rested quietly on a thick branch.
ex.zh: 那只黑豹静静地趴在一根粗壮的树枝上。

ex.en: Protecting forest corridors allows animals such as the panther to move safely between fragmented habitats.
ex.zh: 保护森林廊道可以让黑豹等动物在破碎的栖息地之间安全迁移。

tip: 黑豹通常是黑色的豹或美洲豹，并非独立物种。

senses.en: to complain in an annoyed, often quiet way
a complaint about something that annoys you
to make a low, deep rumbling sound

ex.en: My brother grumbled about washing the dishes again.
ex.zh: 我哥哥抱怨又要洗碗。

ex.en: Although commuters often grumble about delays, many still prefer public transport because it reduces travel costs.
ex.zh: 尽管通勤者经常抱怨延误，许多人仍更愿意乘坐公共交通，因为这能降低出行成本。

col: grumble at someone｜向某人发牢骚
tip: 常用grumble about sth，表示抱怨某事。

senses.en: A strongly defended building or place designed to resist attack.

ex.en: We climbed the hill to explore the old fortress.
ex.zh: 我们爬上山丘，探访那座古老的要塞。

ex.en: Restoring a historic fortress can attract visitors while preserving evidence of a region's military past.
ex.zh: 修复历史要塞既能吸引游客，也能保存当地军事历史的见证。

col: a heavily fortified fortress｜防御严密的要塞
tip: 指防御坚固的要塞；castle更强调城堡建筑。

senses.en: A promise intended to remove doubt or worry.
Confidence in your abilities or in what you believe.

ex.en: She gave me her assurance that dinner was ready.
ex.zh: 她向我保证晚餐已经准备好了。

ex.en: Residents sought an assurance from the council that the new development would not reduce access to public parks.
ex.zh: 居民要求地方议会保证，新开发项目不会影响公众前往公园。

tip: 表示具体保证时可数；表示自信时通常不可数。

senses.en: A safety device that breaks a circuit when current is excessive.
To join together into one whole, often through heat.
A cord or device that makes an explosive charge go off.

ex.en: The electrician replaced the fuse, and the lights came on.
ex.zh: 电工换了保险丝，灯就亮了。

ex.en: Modern design often fuses traditional craftsmanship with digital technology to create more sustainable consumer products.
ex.zh: 现代设计常将传统工艺与数字技术融合，以创造更可持续的消费品。

col: blow a fuse｜烧断保险丝；大发雷霆
tip: 作动词指融合；blow a fuse也可比喻大发雷霆。

senses.en: To protect someone or something from harm or loss.
A measure that prevents harm, loss, or unfair treatment.

ex.en: These padded covers safeguard the furniture during the move.
ex.zh: 这些加厚护套在搬家时保护家具。

ex.en: Governments should introduce stronger regulations to safeguard personal information collected by online services and mobile applications.
ex.zh: 政府应出台更严格的法规，保护在线服务和移动应用收集的个人信息。

col: safeguard personal information｜保护个人信息
a safeguard against fraud｜防范欺诈的措施
tip: 动词常接权益等宾语；名词常接against表示防范对象。

senses.en: welcoming people of different backgrounds and abilities
including all relevant costs
including both the first and last points of a range

ex.en: Our inclusive dance class welcomes people of all abilities.
ex.zh: 我们的舞蹈课注重包容，欢迎各种能力水平的人参加。

ex.en: Schools should create inclusive learning environments where students with different needs can participate fully in classroom activities.
ex.zh: 学校应营造包容的学习环境，让需求不同的学生都能充分参与课堂活动。

tip: inclusive of表示“包含”；日期范围后用它表示首尾均含。

senses.en: one half of the Earth
either of the two halves of the brain

ex.en: Australia lies in the southern hemisphere, far from Europe.
ex.zh: 澳大利亚位于南半球，离欧洲很远。

ex.en: Seasonal differences between the northern and southern hemispheres influence global tourism patterns throughout the year.
ex.zh: 南北半球的季节差异全年都影响着全球旅游模式。

tip: 地理中指地球的一半，也可指大脑半球。

senses.en: A movable panel that covers and protects a window
A camera mechanism controlling how long light enters
To close a building or business, temporarily or permanently

ex.en: I closed the wooden shutters before the storm arrived.
ex.zh: 暴风雨来临前，我关上了木制窗板。

ex.en: Photographers use a fast shutter speed to capture moving wildlife clearly without disturbing its natural behaviour.
ex.zh: 摄影师使用较快的快门速度，在不干扰野生动物自然行为的情况下清晰捕捉其动态。

tip: 窗板常用复数shutters；快门速度用shutter speed。

senses.en: A plant with large, often trumpet-shaped flowers.

ex.en: A white lily opened beside our kitchen window this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早晨，我们厨房窗边的一朵白百合开了。

ex.en: Urban gardens planted with lilies and other flowering species can provide attractive spaces for local residents.
ex.zh: 种有百合和其他开花植物的城市花园能为当地居民提供宜人的空间。

tip: 复数为lilies；water lily指睡莲。

senses.en: having the colour of fresh snow or milk
the colour of fresh snow or milk
the clear part of an egg that turns white when cooked

ex.en: She wore a white cotton shirt to the picnic.
ex.zh: 她穿着一件白色棉衬衫去野餐。

ex.en: Painting roofs white can help buildings reflect sunlight and reduce the energy needed for cooling.
ex.zh: 把屋顶刷成白色有助于建筑物反射阳光，并减少制冷所需的能源。

tip: egg white指蛋清；蛋黄是yolk。
